correctness.rationale: Binary prefix expansion gives an exact finite identity for every 0<alpha<1, independent of numerical checks. The missing-interval argument covers all subset sums because every later term is no smaller than the next term. Finite vs infinite bit patterns yield the exact classification; alpha>=1 is excluded using the monotone gap-defect recurrence. Uniform cylinders give exact binomial distribution and digit strong law gives the almost-sure logarithmic-square count. A standalone exact rational verifier checks 47,101 arithmetic cases and 8,188 dyadic cells; finite tests are supplementary.

originality.rationale: Theorem 1.1 of Wu--Ma gives existence for a general bounded-doubling sequence, not the exact good-scaling locus, a binary-popcount identity, or an exact binomial distribution and almost-sure canonical-hole law. Graham 1971 treats strictly subcritical geometric rays and two-ray questions; the 2022 Ma--Chen public abstract is about the subcritical regime. Searches of research records, titles, formulas, and aliases found no direct coverage; possible unstated older specialization is a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: The complete 2022 Ma--Chen subscription paper was not accessed; an implicit binary-endpoint example remains possible.
Older general subset-sum literature may contain an equivalent specialized result without indexing under dyadic floor rays.
A general Brown criterion can be specialized to this setting; novelty is asserted only for the explicit all-parameter and distributional consequences, not Brown’s criterion itself.

value.rationale: The endpoint growth ratio two is a natural sharp boundary of recently studied completeness theorems; determining the entire scaling locus replaces existence by rigidity. The exact digit-weight identity yields a motivated complete finite distribution, an average quadratic-log hole law, and contrasting arithmetic slopes for 1/7 and 3/7. These quantify an intrinsic nonrepresentability mechanism without pretending the canonical intervals exhaust all holes.
